name: poddle
short: poddle — secret-safe dev sandboxes for coding agents

name: attach
short: Reconnect to a running sandbox
example:
# reconnect to a detached pod's shell
  poddle attach my-sandbox

name: connect
short: Manage service connections (git, CI, …) brokered into pods

name: add
short: Add a service connection (the token is brokered, never stored in a pod)
example:
# pipe the token on stdin so it never hits your shell history
  echo $GITHUB_TOKEN | poddle connect add github --connector forgejo --url https://git.acme.co

flags.name: connector
flags.usage: connector type (forgejo, woodpecker, or a custom one)

flags.name: token
flags.usage: service token (or pipe it on stdin)

name: ls
short: List service connections

name: rm
short: Remove a service connection

name: down
short: Stop and remove a sandbox
example:
# tear down the pod and revoke its handles
  poddle down my-sandbox

name: identity
short: Manage coding-agent logins (identities)

name: add
short: Add an identity by logging into a provider (client-side)
example:
# log into a provider once; the key stays on your machine
  poddle identity add work --provider anthropic

name: ls
short: List identities

name: rm
short: Remove an identity

name: status
short: Check whether an identity is authenticated

name: logs
short: Show a detached task's output
example:
# follow a detached task's output live
  poddle logs poddle-task-9f2a --follow

name: ls
short: List sandboxes

name: move
short: Re-home a pod's session onto a fresh, re-sized shell (keeps workspace + state)
example:
# move onto a bigger shell without losing workspace or agent state
  poddle move my-sandbox --size strong

flags.name: harness
flags.usage: coding-agent runtime (must match the original for state)

name: resize
short: Change a running pod's CPU/memory live (no restart)
example:
# jump to a named size, or set CPU/memory directly
  poddle resize my-sandbox strong
  poddle resize my-sandbox --cpus 8 --memory 16g

flags.name: cpus
flags.usage: CPU ceiling in cores (bursts up to this; idle floats to ~0)

name: run
short: Run a command in a running sandbox
example:
# run a command in a pod without attaching
  poddle run my-sandbox go test ./...

name: stats
short: Show live CPU/memory for running pods

name: task
short: Run a coding agent headless on a prompt in a fresh secretless pod
example:
# one-shot autonomous run in a fresh pod, torn down after
  poddle task "add tests for parseConfig" --identity work
  # burst to a strong pod and keep it to inspect afterward
  poddle task "port the module to v2" --size strong --keep --identity work

flags.name: autoscale
flags.usage: let poddled auto-grow this pod to a bigger shell when it nears its memory limit

flags.name: detach
flags.usage: run the agent in the background; leave the pod up (poddle logs/down)

flags.name: identity
flags.usage: coding-agent login to use (required unless the template sets one)

flags.name: keep
flags.usage: keep the pod running after the task (attach/inspect later)

flags.name: name
flags.usage: pod name (default: a generated poddle-task-* name)

flags.name: template
flags.usage: template to base the pod on

name: up
short: Create a sandbox and connect to it
example:
# a shell wired to your work identity
  poddle up my-sandbox --identity work --harness claude-code
  # from a template, in the background
  poddle up api --template api --identity work --detach

flags.name: autoscale
flags.usage: let poddled warn when this pod nears its memory limit (interactive: warn only)

flags.name: exec
flags.usage: run a command in the sandbox instead of attaching, then tear down

flags.name: harness
flags.usage: coding-agent runtime to run in the sandbox

flags.name: identity
flags.usage: coding-agent login to use in the sandbox

flags.name: template
flags.usage: template to base the sandbox on (from .poddle/ or ~/.config/poddle/templates)

name: version
short: Print the poddle version
